TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: Transaction to execute the creation of the pricing rules
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: 1. Input and validations: execute() obtains pricingRuleRequest through getPricingrule(); ABKOR001Impl.executePostPricingRules() calls validatePostPricingRule(), where PricingRuleValidator.validatePost() validates pricingRuleRequest.effectiveDate.startDate and pricingRuleRequest.effectiveDate.endDate, PricingRuleDuplicateValidator.checkIfPricingRuleAlreadyExistsForPost() checks duplicate candidates using pricingRuleRequest.details and pricingRuleRequest.fee, and PricingRuleRepository.fillDetailValues() resolves pricingRuleRequest.details.value before persistence. 2. Decisions and branches: if pricingRuleRequest.details is null or empty, checkIfPricingRuleAlreadyExistsForPost() skips duplicate validation; if variable candidates exist, PostPricingRuleDuplicateValidator determines EXACT_MATCH, PAYMENT_METHOD_OVERLAP or NONE from detail keys and payment methods; regulated candidate validation runs only when pricingRuleRequest.details contains variable payment methods, and matching regulated candidates only block creation when their fee type and fee value match the input fee. 3. Invoked libraries and methods: execute() obtains ABKOR001 through getServiceLibrary(ABKOR001.class) and calls ABKOR001.executePostPricingRules(pricingRuleRequest); ABKOR001Impl.executePostPricingRules() validates the DTO, gets the request user with getUserId(), obtains audit and pricing rule ids, inserts the audit row with PricingRuleRepository.insertAudit(), inserts the pricing rule with PricingRuleRepository.insertPricingRule(PricingRuleMapper.mapToInsert(...)), inserts detail rows with PricingRuleRepository.insertDetails(), sets pricingRuleDTO.id, and returns the same DTO. 4. Errors and subsequent actions: PricingRuleValidator.validatePost() throws ABKO10000404 when validateDates() returns a non-blank value because the end date is before the start date; UtilPrDuplicateValidation.throwPricingRuleAlreadyExists() throws ABKO10010401 when PostPricingRuleDuplicateValidator.handleVariableExactMatch() or handleRegulatedDuplicate() detects matching detail keys and the candidate fee type and fee value equal the input fee; PostPricingRuleDuplicateValidator.handleVariableExactMatch() throws ABKO10010402 when an exact variable duplicate exists but the candidate fee differs; UtilPrDuplicateValidation.throwPaymentMethodOverlap() throws ABKO10010415 when PostPricingRuleDuplicateValidator.handlePaymentMethodOverlap() finds overlapping payment method details for a variable rule; PricingRuleRepository.fillDetailValues() throws ABKO10010004 when a detail has no configured query, the resolved value is blank, or a NoResultException is raised; ABKOR001Impl.executePostPricingRules() catches PricingRuleException, adds advice with e.getCode() and e.getDescription(), and returns null; after setPricingrule(...), assignSeverityError() sets Severity.EWR whenever adviceList is not empty. 5. Outputs and assignment conditions: execute() always calls setPricingrule(pricingRuleDTO) with the value returned by ABKOR001.executePostPricingRules(), which is the input DTO after detail values are resolved and id is assigned on success or null after a caught PricingRuleException; execute() always calls assignSeverityError(getAdviceList()), and only the presence of advices changes severity, not output assignment.

Accessed Libraries.Description: Creates a pricing rule by validating dates, checking duplicate conflicts, resolving detail values, and persisting the audit, header, and detail records. Returns the same PricingRuleDTO with the generated id and adds advice with the exception code and description when a PricingRuleException is raised.
